approved: Social Security Legislation Amendment (Public Housing Tenants’ Support) Bill 2013
Families, Housing, Community Services and Indigenous Affairs

Opposed the Social Security Legislation Amendment (Public Housing Tenants' Support) Bill 2013, arguing public housing already has a 99.6 per cent rent collection rate, that its 35 per cent income deduction cap would leave a single parent with one child about $24 a day to live on, and proposed spending the bill's $8.6 million cost on services like security upgrades or solar panels for tenants instead.
